title: BudgetV1::deadline_exceeded() uses > not >=. A run that takes exactly max_turn_millis is not considered exceeded. The contract should specify whether equality is over or not, and tests cover only > max and < max, not == max.

title: repo_list calls entry.metadata() which follows symlinks. If a directory entry is a symlink to a very large structure (e.g., a circular symlink), metadata() returns metadata for the target, but the entry kind will be "file" or "dir" — not "symlink". The sandbox could inadvertently expose symlinked-out content via listing.
acceptance_signal: targeted regression plus cargo test/clippy and P28 evidence manifest entry

title: SandboxCapabilityTruthV1::coding_default() denies .recall in denied_prefixes but the memory store is typically ~/.recall. Since the sandbox root is a *repository* path (not $HOME), .recall inside the sandbox root is a different directory from ~/.recall. The prefix check protects the wrong thing.
acceptance_signal: targeted regression plus cargo test/clippy and P28 evidence manifest entry

title: ProviderRouteReportV1::new() sets degraded_reason by joining reason_codes with ", ". If reason_codes is empty, degraded_reason becomes an empty string. But the field is Option<String>, so an empty string looks like a present value even though no reason was provided.
acceptance_signal: targeted regression plus cargo test/clippy and P28 evidence manifest entry

title: JobV1::with_state() updates updated_at: Utc::now() and conditionally sets cancelled_at: Some(Utc::now()). These two Utc::now() calls may produce different timestamps if the system clock ticks between them, so cancelled_at could be *after* updated_at even though cancelled_at is conceptually the time of the state change.
acceptance_signal: targeted regression plus cargo test/clippy and P28 evidence manifest entry

title: HistoryPreservationReportV1::preserves_declared_history() checks !self.degraded && self.before_digest == self.after_digest. A compaction that removes items *and* produces a different digest is correctly flagged. But this means the method returns false for any compaction that actually changed the store, even if all declared invariants are preserved. The digests differing is the *point* of compaction — the check should be whether the post-compaction store satisfies the invariant queries, not whether the digests are identical.
acceptance_signal: targeted regression plus cargo test/clippy and P28 evidence manifest entry

title: ReleaseReadinessReportV1::new() does not check whether any surface in surfaces is in Degraded state — only Blocked blocks release. A degraded surface silently passes the readiness check.
acceptance_signal: targeted regression plus cargo test/clippy and P28 evidence manifest entry

title: InvariantBudgetV1::allows_receipt_compaction() requires approval_receipt_ids to be non-empty if requires_receipt_retention is true. But approval_receipt_ids is never validated for *content* — any non-empty list of IDs (even fabricated ones) satisfies the check.
acceptance_signal: targeted regression plus cargo test/clippy and P28 evidence manifest entry

title: RemovalFrontierV1::new() checks budget.preserves_claim_support() && support_core.support_evidence_ids.contains(evidence_id) to block evidence removal. But support_evidence_ids may be empty (a valid support core with no evidence). In that case, all evidence is removable, even if the invariant budget says claim support must be preserved. The guard should also check whether evidence is needed for claim support.
acceptance_signal: targeted regression plus cargo test/clippy and P28 evidence manifest entry
